verification.notes: Launch mechanics (tagline 60 chars, maker comment, one launch per product) documented in PH help center. Cloudflare bot detection observed historically — automation is not recommended.

media.notes: Gallery images effectively required for launches; demo GIF strongly recommended

links.notes: Product URL is a required launch field

hashtags.notes: Topic tags selected from PH's list

api.notes: PH API v2 (GraphQL) is read-oriented; launch submission is web-only. Draft export is the supported path.

publishing.notes: Historically protected by Cloudflare bot detection. Manual launch is the reliable path; the system produces a complete launch-kit draft.

rateLimit.notes: One launch per product; re-launches allowed only for substantial updates.

culture.audience: Early adopters, founders, investors, tech journalists
